item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 28/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will continue to affect southern China in the next couple of days. A replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong in the latter part of this week. It will be windy over the region. Meanwhile, it will be dry and generally fine over Guangdong. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance, the weather will be cloudier with a few showers over the northern part of the South China Sea and the coast of Guangdong during the weekend and early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kong-rey will intensify gradually and move in the general direction of the vicinity of Taiwan in the next couple of days.
